root.ask_text_note:
This question would be added to Kobool questions database and would be available for other Kobool members to use it if they want to.
Hence it will be reviewed by Kobool supervisor before showing it to others and that could take couple of days.
So you have to consider the following before submitting your question:
1- Your question should not contain personal information or messages for you or whome you are asking
2- Don't mention profile names or detailed information ( for example: city names )
3- Use proper language and avoid bad words

If we found that you are not following these rules that would lead to cancelling your membership and enlisting you to Kobool blacklist.
